title: Ob and Lena timing-gap trends were uncertain in 31 common certified years from 1980 to 2011
abstract: We tested whether growth in the annual-minus-spring flow timing gap at Yenisey also occurred at Ob and Lena. We used 31 common certified years in ArcticGRO v20261104 from 1980 to 2011, excluding 2000. Ob and Lena gap trends were +1.180 and +1.575 days per decade. Their 97.5% five-year block limits were -0.899 to +3.318 and -1.039 to +4.241. Yenisey gave +1.028, with limits of +0.153 to +1.886. Neither difference from Yenisey was clear. Both new river intervals included zero with other block lengths and spring windows. A 1990 start gave a positive Lena interval, so its evidence depends on the start year. The test does not establish a common effect or equality between rivers. Short records, a missing year, fixed windows, regulation and conditional uncertainty limit the result. Code, provenance, aggregate evidence and reproduction instructions are included.
